title: US birth tourism in a book? S. Korean mom's guide draws backlash

blocks.text: From navigating US immigration procedures to making hospital arrangements, a Korean mother’s e-book offering a roadmap to giving birth in America has sparked heated online debate. According to posts circulating on online communities Tuesday, the 12-chapter e-book, “A pregnant woman’s solo journey to give birth in the US on a 30 million won ($22,000) budget,” has been put up for sale online for 350,000 won. The author says on the book’s sales page that she recently traveled to the US while pregnant, gave birth there and returned to South Korea afterward.
